sloka: अतिलक्षणसम्पन्नं माधुर्यगुणभूषितम् ।बुद्ध्या ह्यष्टाङ्गया युक्तं त्वमेवार्हसि भाषितुम् ।। ६.११६.२७ ।।
transliteration: atilakṣaṇasampannaṁ mādhuryaguṇabhūṣitam ।buddhyā hyaṣṭāṅgayā yuktaṁ tvamevārhasi bhāṣitum ।। 6.116.27 ।।

translations.english: "You are a praiseworthy son of wind god. In strength, righteousness, valour, vigour, prowess, skill, you are excellent. You are energetic, endowed with tolerance, forbearance, firmness, brilliance, and humility. You alone have many more qualities, no doubt."
translations.hindi: रावण के घोड़ों को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी श्रोर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के घोड़ों को रावण, घायल करके एक दूसरे से बदला ले रहे थे
